identity.title: List of Pokémon Adventures Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire volumes

leadText: The of Pokémon Adventures is being separately collected into mini-volumes by Shogakukan in Japan, which released up to three volumes total. The volume releases began in July 2015, and later ended in September 2016. Once the ended in the regular volumes, the Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire arc started to be properly collected in that format as well.
